title: Mahooɓe Pilaaruuji Toowɗi
intro: Aɗa darii yeeso ɓulli wuro ɓooyngo mawngo, ɓulli mum toowɗi ɗii njippiima jooni. Henndu nduu ina wulla e nder laabi ɗi ngalaa hay huunde, ina nawra siftorde leñol doolewol meeɗnoongol laamaade ɗeen leyɗeele. Hol ɓe ngonnoo?
clues: Minen ko min leñol doole e karallaagal mawngal, anndiraangal mahdiiji amen mawɗi e siwil amen yahruɗo yeeso.
Min nguuri ko e leydi ɓuuɓndi e kaaƴe, min cikkatnoo hay gooto waawaa foolde min.
Nelaaɗo arii e men e nder banndiraaɓe men, ina noddi en yoo en ndew Alla tan, kono en njaɓaani, en njaltinii mo.
Min mbeltiima no feewi, min mbiyi hol ɓurɗo min semmbe? min njokki e mawnikinaare amen e dewal sanamuuji amen.
Alla neldi e dow men henndu mawndu, ndu fuɗi jammaaji jeeɗiɗi e balɗe jeetati, ndu ɓuuɓni huunde fof.
Minen ko min yim6e Ad, mah6e Iraam, baasal amen wonti jeertinaango wonande ar6e caggal mum fof.

trial.label: Hol jukkungo neldaa e dow maɓɓe?

outcome.label: Hol ko woni darnde maɓɓe haa timmi ?
options: Ɗi mbonnii, heddiiɓe e majji ngonti jannde
Ɓe mberlaa ko e les ɓuuɓol leydi
outcome.answer: Ɗi mbonnii, heddiiɓe e majji ngonti jannde

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
